Table.name: ENTITIES
Table.comment: Designates a thing of interest in this shere of influence (targetenvironment). A being, a tangible or intangible (abstract) object with properties and relationships. It is an IT-system- and technology-independent and consolidated description of the structure and meaning of the thing of interest. An entity name is unique in the considered environment and the definition of the entity (attributes, description, rules, relationships,...) is the only valid interpretation expressed with this name.
Table.notes: [DE_ENTI_COMMENT[ Bezeichnet eine Sache von Interesse in diesem Einflussbereich (Zielumwelt). Ein Wesen, ein materielles oder immaterielles (abstraktes) Objekt mit Eigenschaften und Beziehungen. Es handelt sich um eine IT-System- und Technologie-unabhängige und konsolidierte Beschreibung der Struktur und Bedeutung des interessierenden Dings. Ein Entitätsname ist in der betrachteten Umgebung eindeutig und die Definition der Entität (Attribute, Beschreibung, Regeln, Beziehungen,...) ist die einzig gültige Interpretation, die mit diesem Namen ausgedrückt wird. Eine Entität kann wiederum aus einzelnen Teilen (Attributen, Unterentitäten, Beziehungen, etc.) bestehen ; entsprechend dem Begriff Holon oder Ganzes/Teil. ]DE_ENTI_COMMENT] [EN_ENTI_COMMENT[ Designates a thing of interest in this shere of influence (targetenvironment). A being, a tangible or intangible (abstract) object with properties and relationships. It is an IT-system- and technology-independent and consolidated description of the structure and meaning of the thing of interest. An entity name is unique in the considered environment and the definition of the entity (attributes, description, rules, relationships,...) is the only valid interpretation expressed with this name. ]EN_ENTI_COMMENT]

Column.name: ENTI_NAME
Column.comment: unique Name of the entity normally used in communication.

Column.name: ENTI_PREFIX
Column.comment: Abbreviated name (3-5 characters, usually capital letters) that can be used as a prefix for implementation names.

Column.name: ENTI_DESCRIPTION
Column.comment: Meaning, benefits, usage of the Entity

Column.name: ENTI_SHORT_NAME
Column.comment: nonempty short text for often used for references. Using letters, digits and ' ',-,:,$,_

Column.name: ENTI_SYNONYM
Column.comment: List of synonym names for this thing beeing used in old systems or out of habit. Not unique.

Column.name: ENTI_TOOLTIP
Column.comment: Short text explaining the meaning for the user în the user interface.
